territorial_scope.description: Applies to personal information processors transferring personal information from China to recipients outside the PRC.

evidence.quote: 向中华人民共和国境外提供个人信息，适用本办法。

summary.short: Sets conditions for transferring personal information outside China by concluding the State standard contract with the overseas recipient. Requires a protection impact assessment and filing with the provincial cyberspace authority within 10 working days; bars splitting transfers to avoid security assessment. Effective 1 June 2023.
summary.long: Sets conditions for transferring personal information outside China by concluding the State standard contract with the overseas recipient. Art. 4 limits this route to non-CII processors below caps: under 1 million individuals processed, and since 1 January of the prior year under 100,000 individuals' information and under 10,000 individuals' sensitive information transferred abroad; splitting transfers to avoid a security assessment is barred. Before transfer, the processor must carry out an impact assessment (Art. 5). The contract must follow the Annex, which the regulator may adjust; the contract must take effect before transfer (Art. 6). Within 10 working days of effectiveness the processor files the contract and assessment report with the provincial cyberspace authority (Art. 7); reassessment and refiling are required on specified changes (Art. 8). Regulators must keep information confidential (Art. 9); anyone may report violations (Art. 10); regulators may interview processors facing major risk or incidents (Art. 11). Violations are handled under the PIPL, with criminal liability where applicable (Art. 12). Effective 1 June 2023; non-compliant transfers already under way must be rectified within six months (Art. 13).

definitions.term: 标准合同 (standard contract; 个人信息出境标准合同)

evidence.quote: 个人信息出境标准合同（以下简称标准合同）

obligations.summary: A personal information processor transferring abroad under a standard contract must meet all listed conditions: not a critical information infrastructure operator; fewer than 1 million individuals' personal information processed; cumulative outbound transfer of personal information of fewer than 100,000 individuals since 1 January of the previous year; cumulative outbound transfer of sensitive personal information of fewer than 10,000 individuals since 1 January of the previous year.
obligations.conditional_on: Transfer made by entering into a standard contract with an overseas recipient

evidence.quote: 个人信息处理者通过订立标准合同的方式向境外提供个人信息的，应当同时符合下列情形

obligations.summary: A processor shall not use volume-splitting or similar means to route personal information that must pass an outbound security assessment through a standard contract instead.
obligations.conditional_on: Personal information that by law must pass an outbound security assessment

evidence.quote: 个人信息处理者不得采取数量拆分等手段

obligations.summary: Before providing personal information overseas, the processor shall carry out a personal information protection impact assessment covering the listed matters (legality of purpose and scope, scale and sensitivity, overseas recipient's obligations and safeguards, risks after transfer, foreign data protection environment, other relevant matters).

evidence.quote: 个人信息处理者向境外提供个人信息前，应当开展个人信息保护影响评估

obligations.summary: The standard contract shall be concluded strictly in accordance with the annex to the Measures; the processor may agree other terms with the overseas recipient provided they do not conflict with the standard contract.

evidence.quote: 标准合同应当严格按照本办法附件订立。

obligations.summary: Outbound transfer of personal information may only begin after the standard contract takes effect; transfer before effect is not permitted.
obligations.applies_from: After the standard contract takes effect

obligations.summary: The national cyberspace authority may adjust the annex to the standard contract according to actual circumstances.

obligations.summary: The processor shall file the standard contract and its personal information protection impact assessment report with the provincial-level cyberspace authority of its location, and is responsible for the truthfulness of the filed materials.
obligations.applies_from: Within 10 working days after the standard contract takes effect

evidence.quote: 个人信息处理者应当在标准合同生效之日起10个工作日内向所在地省级网信部门备案。

obligations.summary: Upon the listed changes during the contract term, the processor shall redo the impact assessment and supplement or re-sign the standard contract.
